title: Báo cáo Vận hành
prompt: Cài `OpsReport::snapshot()`: dòng "[ts] CODE key", timestamp tăng dần, bằng timestamp thì REJECT trước ADMIT, xác định từng byte.

tests.name: ops report battery
tests.hint: snapshot sorts by timestamp; ties are broken by code severity (REJECT before ADMIT), then stable insertion order. Lines are exactly "[ts] CODE key\n".

tests.name: determinism battery
tests.hint: snapshot() is pure: repeated calls return byte-identical strings.
